info.name: Glonez Backend
info.description:
Glonez language training centre — Staff + User endpoints, Neero gateway (with anti-spoof callback re-verification + type/amount cross-check), claims, accounts, transfers, withdrawals, and partial-payment support.

Usage:
1. Import the matching environment (Development, Staging, or Production).
2. Run `Staff › Auth › Login` or `User › Auth › Login` — the test script automatically saves `staffToken` / `userToken` to your environment.
3. All staff/user requests pick up the token via `{{staffToken}}` / `{{userToken}}`.

User accounts: only staff can create users. `phone` is **required** (credentials are SMS'd); `email` is optional (extra copy emailed if present).

Partial payments: `POST /users/payments/initiate` accepts an optional `amount`. If omitted, it defaults to whatever is still owed on the class. The server validates `amount <= remaining` (pending intents count against `remaining`). Use `GET /users/payments/class-summary[/:classId]` (or the staff equivalent `GET /staff/payments/class-summary?userId=&classId=`) to see `{ expected, paid, pending, remaining, fullyPaid, paymentsCount }`.

Dev mode (NODE_ENV != production):
The backend routes payment & withdrawal calls to an in-process simulator, so use `+237670000001` (the value of `{{devTestPhone}}`) as the phone. Send header `x-simulate-outcome: failed` to force a failed outcome (default = success).

Neero callbacks:
One endpoint receives both payment and withdrawal callbacks (`POST /api/public/callbacks/neero`). The server discriminates by the prefix of `externalTransactionId` (`PAY-…` → Payment, `WDR-…` → Withdrawal). PENDING callbacks are acknowledged and ignored. For non-pending callbacks, the server re-queries Neero using the stored `gatewayReference` (the Neero `transactionIntentId`) and additionally cross-checks the returned intent's `type` (must be `CASHIN` for payments, `CASHOUT` for withdrawals) and `amount`. The callback body itself never drives the status update — spoofed payloads are dropped.

Neero payment-method cache:
The server keeps a local `(phoneNumber, provider) → neeroPaymentMethodId` cache so repeat payments and withdrawals skip the extra `POST /payment-methods` round-trip.

Pagination: list endpoints accept `pageNum` (default 1) and `pageSize` (default 10).

Response shape: every endpoint returns HTTP 200 with `{ success, data, errorMsg, errorCode }`. Frontends gate on `success` + `errorCode`.

header.description: Required only if NEERO_WEBHOOK_SECRET is configured.

exec: if (r && r.success && r.data && r.data.user) pm.environment.set('userFriendlyId', r.data.user.userId);

request.description: Phone is required (credentials are SMS'd). Email is optional — if provided a copy of the credentials is also emailed.
Every class this user has been enrolled in. The row with `isActive: true` is their current class; other rows are past classes with `leftAt` set when they were promoted out.
Manager+ only. A disabled user cannot log in; existing sessions return errorCode 2005 (ACCOUNT_DISABLED) on the next authenticated request.

Create up to 500 users in one call.

- Per-row: `name` and `phone` required; `email` and `classId` optional.
- `options.skipDuplicates` (default `true`): a row whose phone or email already exists is moved to `skipped` rather than failing the row.
- Returns `{ summary, created, skipped, failed }`. Each list carries the original row `index` so the UI can map outcomes back to its grid.
- Credentials are SMS'd to every created user (email copy when provided). One transport failing does not roll back the user record.

exec: if (r && r.success && r.data && r.data.class) pm.environment.set('classFriendlyId', r.data.class.classId);

request.description:
Returns the class plus `stats`:
- studentCount, fullyPaidCount, partiallyPaidCount, unpaidCount
- totalExpected = studentCount * fee
- totalPaid (each student capped at fee, so over-payments don't inflate)
- totalRemaining = totalExpected - totalPaid

query.description: Single status — e.g. pending, successful, failed, cancelled, refunded.

request.description: Filter by `status` as either a single value, a comma-separated list (`?status=pending,failed`), or a repeated key (`?status=pending&status=failed`). Invalid values are silently dropped.

Admin-only rolled-up balances across every active account.

- `companyBalance`      = system account (type: 'company').
- `operationalBalance`  = company + all staff accounts (funds actively movable through Neero / manager balances).
- `totalBalance`        = company + staff + virtual (everything under book-keeping).

`perType` and `counts` expose the raw group sums and counts for building a breakdown chart on the frontend.

exec: if (r && r.success && r.data && r.data.account) pm.environment.set('virtualAccountId', r.data.account.accountId);

request.description: Admin-only. Creates a purely internal book-keeping account (bank, wallet, cash box, …). No external funding — balance changes are made via the Adjust endpoint. `name` is required; `logoUrl`, `description`, `currencyCode`, and starting `balance` are optional.

Admin-only. Manually credit or debit any company or virtual account. Writes one ADJUSTMENT transaction to the account's statement. Use `{{virtualAccountId}}` for virtual accounts or the company account's `accountId` (from `GET /accounts/me` as admin) to mirror external Neero withdrawals.

query.description: Admin-only filter (friendly id, e.g. STF-XXXXXXXX). Ignored when called by non-admin.

request.description: Non-admin staff see only their own withdrawal accounts. Admin sees all and can narrow by `?staffId=STF-XXXXXXXX`.
MTN/Orange accounts require SMS-OTP verification. After creating, call Verify with the OTP.

Neero personal accounts skip OTP — this endpoint lets the staff pre-verify a phone number resolves to a real Neero account before submitting the Add request.

Server strips the country code prefix (e.g. `+237`) before calling Neero's `/api/v1/payment-methods` with `{ type: 'NEERO_PERSON', personDetailsWithPhoneNumber: { countryCode: 'CM', phoneNumber: <local> } }`.

Returns `{ neeroAccount: { id, shortInfo, phoneNumber } }`. Neero doesn't echo the phone back, so the server adds it in. No WithdrawalAccount is persisted here; the payment-method cache is warmed so the subsequent Add call is a free lookup.

Outside production the endpoint returns a `dev: true` stub.

Personal Neero account, identified by the phone number tied to it. Neero has already KYC'd the underlying account, so we trust it on creation — no OTP loop.

In production, adding the account also warms the local NeeroPaymentMethod cache: the server calls Neero's `POST /api/v1/payment-methods` with `{ type: 'NEERO_PERSON', personDetailsWithPhoneNumber: { countryCode: 'CM', phoneNumber } }`. The returned payment-method id is cached so later cash-outs skip the round-trip. If Neero rejects, the WDA is NOT created (errorCode 3002).
Admin-only — lists the target manager's withdrawal accounts so the admin can pick one before initiating a payout.

Admin-only. Performs three steps atomically per the spec:
  1. Debit the default company account by `amount`.
  2. Credit the beneficiary staff's account by `amount`.
  3. Initiate the gateway cash-out to the chosen withdrawal account.

On synchronous success the staff is debited again so the ledger nets to zero (the credit + debit pair leaves a clear audit trail). On gateway failure both ledger legs are reversed.

Provider limits (per transaction): MTN 500,000 — Orange 400,000 — Neero unlimited.

exec: if (r && r.success && r.data && r.data.expense) pm.environment.set('expenseFriendlyId', r.data.expense.expenseId);

request.description: Debits the caller's account by `amount` and adds an EXPENSE row to their statement. For non-admin staff the spend hits their personal account; for admin it hits the default company account.
Non-admin staff see only their own expenses; admin sees all and can filter by `staffId`.

exec: if (r && r.success && r.data && r.data.staff) pm.environment.set('beneficiaryStaffId', r.data.staff.staffId);

query.description: Substring search on name / email / staffId.

request.description: Use `?email=` for an exact (case-insensitive) match — handy when picking a beneficiary by email. Use `?q=` for fuzzy/substring search across name, email, and staffId.
Admin only. `isActive` is NOT accepted here — use the dedicated /disable and /enable endpoints below so the role-hierarchy guard is always applied.

Open to any authenticated staff, but enforces role hierarchy:
- You cannot disable yourself (`cannot_disable_self`, 1003).
- You cannot disable an admin (`cannot_disable_admin`, 1003).
- Your role must be STRICTLY GREATER than the target's (`cannot_disable_higher_role`, 1003).

So a manager (600) can disable an auditor (500) or support (200); only admin can disable a manager.
Same role-hierarchy rules as Disable — re-enabling an auditor requires manager+ for example.

Case-insensitive substring match on the URL.

request.description: Audit trail of every outbound third-party call (currently Neero). 30-day retention via TTL. Authorization headers are redacted before persistence. Any authenticated staff can browse.
Full class history for the logged-in user. `isActive: true` = current class.
Pay only part of the class fee. Server validates amount <= remaining (pending intents count against remaining). Omit `amount` to default to the full remaining balance.

formdata.description: Required. Must reference one of YOUR payments that is NOT successful (pending/failed/cancelled).

request.description:
Raise a claim against a non-successful payment. `paymentId` is mandatory; the server rejects with VALIDATION (1001) if the referenced payment is already successful, and PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND (3004) if it doesn't exist or doesn't belong to you.

`amount` and `currencyCode` are NOT sent by the client — they're snapshotted from the referenced payment so the disputed sum always matches the underlying record.
